name: M4 Requirements panel: honest UNKNOWN, conflicts resolved by a person, the domain classifier
description: Execution brief M4.2/M4.3 (ADR-0060, schema v11). On an isolated fixture project the power source is recorded CONFIRMED as USB-C 5 V and then a second source records a 12 V barrel jack (fixture-commands, SETUP through the execute_command IPC the panel uses): the engine keeps it beside the first value as a conflict instead of overwriting it. In the real window View > Show Requirements opens the Requirements panel, read through the requirements_report IPC. The input voltage nobody answered is shown as UNKNOWN, never as a number. The power-source row shows both values. Keep stays disabled until a person names themself; once a name is typed, Keep on the recorded value resolves the conflict (ResolveRequirementConflict) and the value becomes CONFIRMED. Classify runs the deterministic domain classifier (ClassifyDomain): the confirmed USB-C source is strong, firm evidence, so the USB overlay is recorded DERIVED. Reject records the person's decision that it does not apply (CONFIRMED no). Enter on the input voltage records a nominal 5 V as NEEDS_CONFIRMATION with its risk (SetRequirementField), and Confirm makes it CONFIRMED. Every edit is an engine command; the panel computes nothing itself.
